pr_title: feat: filter to show verified or unverified users
pr_body: ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? Studio Feature Fixed https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues/3330 ## What is the current behavior? At the moment in Supabase Studio Auth their is only a search field for an email and no filter to show verified/unverified users: ## What is the new behavior? A new filter has been added so that the list can be filtered to show all, verified and unverified users in the list: https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22655069/172126476-01d23439-12e9-4324-9250-19609ec9d7cb.mov ## Additional context This is linked to issue #3330 @MildTomato @phamhieu @joshenlim

Hey @Hallidayo ! This is great, thank you! I think a plain Listbox makes sense for this one instead of a Select, and we can probably skip the icon. @Hallidayo I do see the spinner! And requests are being made, but I get the same results back.

@saltcod - The verified users is running the following query if no search word is being used:

`SELECT * from auth.users WHERE (email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL or phone_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`

Whilst un-verified is doing the following:

`SELECT * from auth.users WHERE (email_confirmed_at IS NULL AND phone_confirmed_at IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`

Are the values for `email_confirmed_at` and `phone_confirmed_at` in your `auth.users` table set to `NULL`? Whilst testing I had to set values for one of these fields in in the `auth.users` table so I could test the different scenarios

issue_context.title: Add ability to filter auth table by able to show only verified or unverified email of auth user
issue_context.body: Once there is too many user registered its hard to track user that are verified and not yet verified

review_comments:
Small nitpick

Do you mind changing this to something like:


```
let queryObj = {
    limit: this.pageLimit,
        offset: (this.page - 1) * this.pageLimit,
        keywords: this.filterKeywords,
}

return this.filterVerified ? {...queryObj, verified: this.filterVerified} : queryObj
```

Other than that LGTM, also merge master since there seems to be a conflict on the Users component. Thanks!
